summary: Smith & Nephew plc filed a Form 6-K on September 9, 2026, disclosing transactions by a person discharging managerial responsibilities under the UK Market Abuse Regulation. Chief Strategy and Corporate Development Officer Ajay Dhankhar had 27,524 shares vest under the Global Share Plan 2020 and 13,472 under the Restricted Share Plan 2024 on September 7, 2026, with portions sold at £10.433776 on the London Stock Exchange to cover tax liabilities, the remainder retained. This is a routine PDMR shareholding notification, not a special situation; no deal terms, advisors, or board recommendations are implicated.
